the proposed center-loss based CNNs can learn a more discriminative feature for face recognition, and the proposed CNNs can be used for both face recognition task and face verification task.
we propose a discriminative feature learning approach for deep face recognition, which is easy to be implemented and can achieve state of the art performance on several important face benchmarks.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, with joint supervision of the softmax loss and the center loss, a robust CNNs can be trained, which can achieve the state of art performance on face recognition.
the center loss can be used as an effective supervision signal in CNNs to improve the discriminative power for face recognition task.
the center loss can be used as an effective regularizer in the deep networks for face recognition.
